REPORT
Subject (in full) Deportation of Russian shoplifters from Japan.
Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by W.H. Cumming A.C.P.
Sir,
Information has been received to the
effect that A.B. Finkershtein, Abramovitch Goridberg and
Valentina Petorona Rogentaly, Russian shoplifters, arrested
by the Tokyo Police on charges of shoplifting, will arrive
in Shanghai on April 24, 1931 aboard the N.Y.K. S.S. "Aso
Maru," being deported from Japan.
A detailed report on the activities
of these persons in Japan was submitted by C.D.I. Nakagawa
on April 2, 1931.
M Umemoto
J. D. S.
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

Translation of a report addressed to the Chief of Police,
Japanese Consulate-General at Shanghai, by the Chief of
the Foreign Section of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Board.
------------------------------------

Re-Foreigners arrested on charges of shoplifting,
------------------------------------
A. B. Finkershtein, 40 years of age, tailor, Russian Jew,
155 Avenue Louye, Hankow French Concession.
Abramovitch Goridberg, 38 years of age, Auction Broker,
Russian Jew, 20 Wayside Road, Shanghai.
Valentina Rogentaly, 30 years of age, dress-maker, Russian
Jewess, wife of Michael Abramovitch Fershtein, 166 Seward
Road, Shanghai.

    In reply to your letter dated March 18, 1931 asking
for information re the arrest of a gang of Shanghai shop-
lifters, I beg to inform you that the three persons
mentioned above were arrested on charges of shop-lifting and
were detained pending further enquiries.

    Finkershtein admits that on March 12, 1931 he stole
111 feet of satin valued at ¥90.00 from 3/6 Muro Machi,
Nihonbashi-Ku, Tokyo, a shop owned by M. Ohtaki,
woollen merchant. He states that he came to Japan to get
his passport vised in order to leave for Argentine. The
passport in his possession is a forged one.

    On February 23, 1931 the three persons were present at
3/36 Benten Dori, Naka-Ku, Yokohama, a shop owned by T.
Hosone, silk merchant, when a quantity of silk was stolen
from the place.

    Judging from modus operandi of these persons, it is
most probable that they are professional shoplifters
operating between Japan and China.

    I enclose herewith their finger-prints and photographs.
Please make the necessary investigations and furnish me
with information at your earliest convenience.
pages.zh:
译自东京警视厅外事科科长致上海日本总领事馆警务主管的报告。
------------------------------------

关于因涉嫌扒窃被捕的外国人，
------------------------------------
A. B. Finkershtein，40岁，裁缝，俄罗斯犹太人，住址：汉口法租界卢业路（Avenue Louye）155号。
Abramovitch Goridberg，38岁，拍卖经纪人，俄罗斯犹太人，住址：上海韦思德路（Wayside Road）20号。
Valentina Rogentaly，30岁，服装师，俄罗斯犹太女性，Michael Abramovitch Fershtein 之妻，住址：上海西华德路（Seward Road）166号。

    复贵方1931年3月18日来信，询问关于一伙上海扒手被捕的信息，谨告知上述三人因涉嫌扒窃被捕，并在进一步调查期间被拘留。

    Finkershtein 承认，他于1931年3月12日从东京日本桥区室町（Muro Machi）3/6号羊毛商 M. Ohtaki 拥有的商店偷走了价值90.00日元的111英尺缎子。他声称来日本是为了签证护照以便前往阿根廷。他所持有的护照是伪造的。

    1931年2月23日，这三人在横滨中区弁天通（Benten Dori）3/36号丝绸商 T. Hosone 拥有的商店时，该店被盗走一批丝绸。

    从这些人的作案手法来看，他们极有可能是活跃于日本和中国之间的职业扒手。

    现附上他们的指纹和照片。请进行必要的调查，并尽早向我提供信息。

pages.en:
(2)

Finkershtein denies that he is A. Brodosky whose
photograph you have sent to me, although their features
are identical.

Suspicious points in passports

1) The colour of the paper of the genuine passport is
green; the paper is thick and strong. The colour of their
passport is light blue and the paper is of inferior quality
bearing the watermarks of the manufacturer.

2) Consul's signature
The signature of T. Katil, Lithuanian Consul at
Harbin, on their passports is absolutely different from
the genuine signature.

3) Consulate Chop
The margin on genuine passport is covered with
five pointed satrs, but crosses appear on their passports.

4) Wording
French and Lithuanian wording is used in genuine
passports and the words "Lithuanian Consulate in China"
are written in small Chinese characters, but in their passports
German words are used in the column for profession and the
Chinese characters are printed in bigger type.

How they obtained the passports

Finkershtein and Goridberg state that they obtained
the passports at an auction-room in Shanghai from a
Chinese nicknamed "Vassily" for Gold $10.00. Vassily is
about 34 years of age and speaks Russian fluently. Rogentaly
states that the passport was obtained by her husband
Fershtein.

Their statements cannot be confirmed.
pages.zh:
(2)

Finkershtein 否认他是 A. Brodosky，尽管您发给我的照片中两人的相貌特征完全相同。

护照中的可疑点

1) 真实护照的纸张颜色为绿色；纸张厚实坚固。他们的护照颜色为浅蓝色，纸质较差，带有制造商的水印。

2) 领事签名
他们护照上哈尔滨立陶宛领事 T. Katil 的签名与真实签名完全不同。

3) 领事馆印章
真实护照的边缘覆盖着五角星，但他们的护照上出现的是十字形。

4) 措辞
真实护照使用法语和立陶宛语措辞，“在华立陶宛领事馆”字样用小号中文汉字书写，但在他们的护照中，职业栏使用德语单词，且汉字印刷字体较大。

他们如何获得护照

Finkershtein 和 Goridberg 声称，他们在上海的一家拍卖行从一个绰号“Vassily”的中国人那里以10.00金元的价格获得了护照。Vassily 约34岁，能流利地说俄语。Rogentaly 声称护照是由她的丈夫 Fershtein 获得的。

他们的陈述无法证实。

REPORT
Date March 16, 19 31
Subject (in full) Arrest of three Russian Shoplifters in Tokyo, Japan.
Made by D. S. Oviannikoff Forwarded by Det. Supt. Yorke

Sir,
With reference to the attached translation of the article
published by the Shanghai Nippo, dated March 14, 1931 re arrest
of three Russian Shoplifters in Tokyo, Japan, I beg to report
that the names given by the newspaper are not known to the Police.
From enquiries made it appears that a female Shoplifter named
Anastasia Kutcheskova and males Issy Mull and A. Troisky are
at present in Tokyo, Japan, where they arrived from Shanghai
about 2 weeks ago, travelling under an assumed name on
Lithuanian passports, which they obtained in Shanghai from
Steidloff, well known forger. About 2 months ago I informed
S.D.I. Nakagawa that several Russian Shoplifters are travelling
between Shanghai and Japan on Lithuanian passports and he
communicated this information to the Japanese Consulate. About
a week ago several Russian Shoplifters including D. Jedidine
residing in the Crystal Hotel, 39 Seyuri Road, returned in
Shanghai from Japan and it was ascertained that they also travel-
led on the said passports to Japan, but in view of the fact that
the Japanese Police in Nagasaki was already informed by the
local Japanese Consulate regarding their movements they could not
proceed further than Nagasaki and were obliged to return to
Shanghai. There is no official representative of the Lithuanian
Government in Shanghai as Lithuania is not recognized by
China.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
V. Oviannikoff
D. S.

由 D. S. Oviannikoff 撰写 由警司 Yorke 转呈

先生，
关于附上的1931年3月14日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）发表的关于在日本东京逮捕三名俄罗斯扒手的文章译文，谨报告称，警方并不知晓报纸上给出的名字。
经查询，似乎名为 Anastasia Kutcheskova 的女扒手以及名为 Issy Mull 和 A. Troisky 的男子目前就在日本东京，他们大约两周前从上海抵达那里，使用在上海从著名伪造者 Steidloff 处获得的立陶宛护照，并以假名旅行。大约两个月前，我曾告知 S.D.I. Nakagawa，有几名俄罗斯扒手持立陶宛护照在上海和日本之间往来，他将此信息通报给了日本领事馆。大约一周前，包括居住在色玉里路（Seyuri Road）39号水晶酒店（Crystal Hotel）的 D. Jedidine 在内的几名俄罗斯扒手从日本返回上海，经查实，他们也持上述护照前往日本，但由于长崎的日本警察已通过当地日本领事馆获悉他们的动向，他们未能越过长崎，被迫返回上海。由于中国不承认立陶宛，上海没有立陶宛政府的官方代表。

March 14, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

RUSSIAN LUMBER MERCHANT FINANCES COMMUNISTS

The Shanghai Mainichi publishes the following report:-
It is reported that a Russian lumber merchant living at No. 1 Boone Road, which was raided by the Municipal Police in 1929 on suspicion of being the headquarters of communists in Shanghai, is now financing Red Russian activities in China.
Since the closing of the Far Eastern Bank on Szechuen Road the lumber merchant has been supporting the activities of Chinese communists with a large sum of money.
The firm ostensibly belongs to a private person but in reality it belongs to the Soviet.

JAPANESE FISHING BOATS RELEASED BY THE CUSTOMS

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following report:-
The Japanese fishing boats Rypha Maru and Taika Maru held by the Chinese Customs at Woosung for breach of a Customs notification were released yesterday.
They will leave for Tsingtao to-day.

TOKYO POLICE ARREST 3 RUSSIAN SHOPLIFTERS

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following report:-
A Rengo telegram from Tokyo dated March 13 reports that on March 12 the Tokyo Police arrested 3 Russians: a woman named Varemchina Rosentarik, 33, and two men named Rachilai Burlpoberg, 38, and A. I. Anofinchinshipein, 43. These three persons used to live in the French Concession, Shanghai, China.
(They were arrested by the Japanese Police as they were attempting to steal silk valued at Yen 220 from the Mitsukoshi Department Store on Nihon Bashi, Tokyo.
The Police have ascertained that the Russians have been stealing goods at Tientsin, Shanghai, Kobe, Yokohama, Osaka and Tokyo.

杂项

俄罗斯木材商资助共产党

《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）刊登如下报道：-
据报道，一名居住在布恩路（Boone Road）1号的俄罗斯木材商，曾在1929年因涉嫌作为上海共产党总部而被工部局警务处搜查，现在正资助赤色俄罗斯在中国的活动。
自四川路的远东银行关闭以来，该木材商一直用巨额资金支持中国共产党员的活动。
该公司表面上属于私人所有，但实际上属于苏维埃。

日本渔船被海关释放

《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登如下报道：-
因违反海关通告而被中国海关在吴淞扣押的日本渔船“龙波丸”（Rypha Maru）和“大化丸”（Taika Maru）于昨日获释。
它们将于今天启程前往青岛。

东京警察逮捕3名俄罗斯扒手

《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登如下报道：-
据3月13日从东京发出的联合通讯社电报报道，3月12日东京警察逮捕了3名俄罗斯人：一名名叫 Varemchina Rosentarik 的33岁女子，以及两名分别名叫 Rachilai Burlpoberg（38岁）和 A. I. Anofinchinshipein（43岁）的男子。这三个人以前住在中国上海的法租界。
（他们在试图从东京日本桥的三越百货公司偷窃价值220日元的丝绸时被日本警察逮捕。
警方已查明，这些俄罗斯人一直在天津、上海、神户、横滨、大阪和东京盗窃商品。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
Station,
S. D. D. 2145.
Date March 14, 1931.
REPORT

Subject (in full) Arrest of a gang of Russian shoplifters by Tokyo Police.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by Whouman API.

Sir,

Information has been received to the
effect that Valentina Rosentaric ?, 30, Ruchirai Priveberg ?,
38, and A.B. Abfintinshhein ?, 40, were arrested on March
12, 1931 by the Tokyo Police on a charge of shoplifting.
Thirteen pieces of silk, valued at ¥220, were stolen by
them from the Mitsukoshi Department Store in Tokyo.

They are reported to have been living
in the French Concession, Shanghai, where they organized
a gang of shoplifters. After committing offences in Shanghai
and Tientsin, they went over to Japan.

They are being detained by the Tokyo
Police who are conducting further investigations.

A further report will be submitted upon
the receipt of any information regarding these persons, who
will undoubtedly be deported to Shanghai after serving
any term of imprisonment imposed upon them.

M. Umemoto
J. D. S.

档案编号
分局，
S. D. D. 2145。
日期 1931年3月14日。
报告

事由（全称） 东京警察逮捕一伙俄罗斯扒手。

呈报人 J.D.S. Umemoto。转呈人 Whouman API。

敬启者，

兹接获情报称，Valentina Rosentaric ?（30岁）、Ruchirai Priveberg ?（38岁）及 A.B. Abfintinshhein ?（40岁）于1931年3月12日因犯有商店扒窃罪被东京警察逮捕。他们在东京三越百货店（Mitsukoshi Department Store）窃得价值220日元的丝绸十三件。

据报，这些人此前居住在上海法租界，并在那里组织了一个扒窃团伙。在上海和天津作案后，他们前往日本。

目前他们正被东京警察拘留，警方正在进行进一步调查。

一旦收到关于这些人的任何消息，将另行提交报告；他们在服完判处的刑期后，无疑将被驱逐至上海。

M. Umemoto
J. D. S.
